name: motonav
description: MotoNav — group motorcycle ride navigation. Stage 3: real group rides, shareable links, live co-rider tracking.

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run server"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('\n\u001b[33m[motonav] Frontend deps installed. This project ALSO has a separate backend in server/. Run: npm run server:install && npm run server:migrate && npm run dev:full\u001b[0m\n')"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev" "npm run server"
